name: portal-pai-smp
description: Portal Web Pembelajaran Terpadu Pendidikan Agama Islam (PAI) Kelas 7, 8, 9

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const s = spawn('node', ['server/index.js'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"

author: Antigravity
